about: The links the baseline loads (tools/baseline.mjs). Each query is appended to the page address as it stands; the page fills every key it is not given from its own defaults (MDF, compression, 12.7 mm, 2 flutes, 18 mm board, 18000 rpm, the Generic machine at index 7, Standard, first cut on; drilling: hinge drill, 35 mm, 13 mm hole). Actions use a control's role and accessible name, not its markup, so they still work on the converted page. Written 2026-09-24.

states.name: routing-default-page-no-link
states.shows: The page opened with no query at all: MDF, compression 12.7 mm, full board and full slot (both optional boxes empty), Generic machine, Standard, first cut on.

states.name: material-melamine-downcut-6.35
states.shows: Melamine / chipboard with a down-cut spiral, which reads two data materials (laminated_pb and laminated_chipboard).

states.name: material-hard-plywood-compression-12.7
states.shows: Hard plywood with a compression tool.

states.name: material-soft-plywood-upcut-6.35
states.shows: Soft plywood with an up-cut spiral, the one material with a fallback to the plywood charts.

states.name: material-hpl-compression-12.7
states.shows: HPL-faced panel with a compression tool.

states.name: material-hardwood-upcut-6.35
states.shows: Hardwood with an up-cut spiral.

states.name: material-softwood-straight-12.7
states.shows: Softwood with a straight-flute tool.

states.name: tool-upcut-12.7-mdf
states.shows: Up-cut spiral at 12.7 mm in MDF (compression at 12.7 is the default page).

states.name: tool-downcut-12.7-mdf
states.shows: Down-cut spiral at 12.7 mm in MDF.

states.name: tool-straight-12.7-mdf
states.shows: Straight-flute tool at 12.7 mm in MDF.

states.name: tool-ball-12.7-mdf-depth-empty
states.shows: Ball nose at 12.7 mm in MDF with the depth box empty, which the page reads as the full board.

states.name: ball-12.7-mdf-depth-0.5-stepover-1.3
states.shows: Ball nose surfacing pass: 0.5 mm depth, 1.3 mm stepover. The ball geometry rows (scallop, cutting diameter, its surface speed) appear.

states.name: ball-12.7-mdf-depth-2-stepover-1.3
states.shows: Ball nose at 2 mm depth, same stepover.

states.name: ball-12.7-mdf-depth-6-stepover-5
states.shows: Ball nose at 6 mm depth, just under the radius, with a 5 mm stepover.

states.name: ball-6.35-hardwood-depth-1-stepover-0.6
states.shows: A smaller ball in hardwood, 1 mm depth.

states.name: routing-finishing-mdf-compression-12.7
states.shows: The Finishing profile: finisher charts serve, the first-cut box is hidden, the 1 mm skim is assumed.

states.name: routing-first-cut-off
states.shows: First-cut reduction switched off, so the chart feed serves in full.

states.name: routing-gentle-3-flutes-22000rpm
states.shows: Gentle profile, three flutes, a spindle speed other than the default.

states.name: routing-aggressive-upcut-depth-6-width-3
states.shows: Aggressive profile, up-cut spiral, with both optional boxes filled: 6 mm depth per pass, 3 mm width of cut.

states.name: machine-0-biesse-rover-bs
states.shows: Machine preset 0, Biesse Rover B/S: a spindle power range (the lower value serves) and no published feed (the reference default fills in, and the note says so).

states.name: machine-1-scm-morbidelli-x50
states.shows: Machine preset 1, SCM Morbidelli X50.

states.name: machine-2-scm-morbidelli-m100-x100
states.shows: Machine preset 2, SCM Morbidelli M100/X100.

states.name: machine-3-scm-morbidelli-m200-x200
states.shows: Machine preset 3, SCM Morbidelli M200/X200, which publishes a 50 m/min feed.

states.name: machine-4-scm-morbidelli-m600-800
states.shows: Machine preset 4, SCM Morbidelli M600/800.

states.name: machine-5-homag-centateq-n500
states.shows: Machine preset 5, Homag Centateq N-500.

states.name: machine-6-anderson-stratos-pro
states.shows: Machine preset 6, Anderson Stratos Pro: no published spindle power, so the reference default serves and the machine note says so.

states.name: machine-8-heliner-3-axis
states.shows: Machine preset 8, Heliner 3-axis router. (Preset 7, Generic, is the default page.)

states.name: advanced-machine-feed-cap-20-m-min
states.shows: The advanced machine max feed set to 20 m/min, which the page multiplies by 1000 into 20000 mm/min before the engine sees it. Aggressive, four flutes, 24000 rpm, so the chart feed is above 20 m/min and the machine feed cap binds.

states.name: advanced-overrides-hardwood-density-corner-conventional
states.shows: Advanced overrides: timber density 700, smallest feature 50 mm (turns on the corner check), conventional direction, up-cut-only flute convention.

states.name: advanced-hold-down-binds-small-footprint
states.shows: A 20 cm² part footprint on the vacuum, so the hold-down cap binds and the limit line turns danger.

states.name: refusal-ball-nose-finishing
states.shows: A refusal: no finisher chart covers a ball nose.

states.name: refusal-ball-nose-in-hpl
states.shows: A refusal: the ball nose chart covers softwood, hardwood and MDF only.

states.name: block-depth-over-3x-diameter
states.shows: A block: a 3.175 mm tool through an 18 mm board is 5.7 times its diameter.

states.name: block-compression-pass-too-shallow
states.shows: A block: a 2 mm pass with a compression tool leaves the up-cut section lifting the top face.

states.name: four-warnings-fold-into-one-list
states.shows: Four warnings (speed clamped, chip ploughing, the ITA speed caveat, big-iron charts) fold into one banner carrying a list. From test SC30's sweep.

states.name: drill-hinge-35-published-speed
states.shows: Drilling's defaults: hinge drill 35 mm, 13 mm hole, the speed box empty so the published speed serves.

states.name: drill-hinge-26
states.shows: Hinge drill at 26 mm.

states.name: drill-dowel-5
states.shows: Dowel drill at 5 mm, a shelf-pin hole.

states.name: drill-dowel-8-hole-30
states.shows: Dowel drill at 8 mm, a 30 mm hole. No peck row: no dowel drill source publishes a clearing rule.

states.name: drill-through-5
states.shows: Through-hole drill at 5 mm.

states.name: drill-through-8
states.shows: Through-hole drill at 8 mm.

states.name: drill-twist-3
states.shows: Twist drill at 3 mm.

states.name: drill-twist-8-hardwood-hole-40-peck
states.shows: Twist drill at 8 mm in hardwood, a 40 mm hole: past four diameters, so the peck row and its note appear (the double-heel twist drill is the one family that publishes a clearing rule).

states.name: drill-bank-on-hinge-35
states.shows: The drill bank ticked: the router spindle's speed floor no longer applies and its range is not drawn.

states.name: drill-speed-given-dowel-8-4000rpm
states.shows: Drilling with the speed box filled, 4000 rpm, on the SCM X50.

states.name: drill-gentle-melamine-dowel-5
states.shows: Drilling on the Gentle profile in melamine.

states.name: drill-machine-feed-cap-0.5-m-min
states.shows: The advanced machine max feed at 0.5 m/min in drilling, which caps the plunge (drilling caps on the machine feed only).

states.name: fallback-finishing-link-opened-in-drilling
states.shows: A Finishing link opened in drilling falls back to Standard, because drilling offers no Finishing.

states.name: fallback-drill-family-link-snaps-diameter
states.shows: A dowel link with no diameter: the drilling default of 35 mm is not a dowel size, so it snaps to the nearest one the family publishes.

states.name: fallback-drill-family-change-snaps-diameter
states.shows: Opened on the 35 mm hinge drill, then the Twist drill is picked: the diameter snaps to the nearest twist size.

states.name: fallback-mode-switch-parks-finishing
states.shows: Opened on Finishing in routing, switched to Drilling (Finishing is not offered, Standard serves), then back to Routing (Finishing returns).

states.name: old-link-before-drilling
states.shows: A link in the format the page wrote before drilling existed (2026-08-18 to 2026-08-31, commit cabfddd): no mode key, keys in the old order, the machine values the old page wrote as a_ keys. It must still read as routing.
